_note: Two matched Qwen3.6-35B-A3B runs on 4xA100-80GB each, identical except training data: base = woog prepared-v2; mix = prepared-v2 + curated rain1 data (setup_mix.py, mix-spec.json). Same recipe as woog's moe-A-full-lr1e4 except warmup 0.06 -> 0.10, micro-batch 8 -> 4 (same effective batch 32), automatic rollback, and dev-half checkpoint selection. Rationale in README.md#moe-run. Length is passed at launch (launch_moe.py --fraction) and is the same for both runs.
